## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(cli): ...`, `fix(mcpd): ...`).
- [ ] There is an accepted issue for this, or it is a fix or a docs change.
- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] A changeset is included (`pnpm changeset`) if users would notice the change.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin).
- [ ] No tokens, real emails, account names or personal paths in code, tests or fixtures.
